brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a residential building in Nablus, in the northern West Bank, and two additional residential structures in Ramallah governorate on Monday, Shehab Wire reported. Local and security sources confirmed the forces were accompanied by a bulldozer during the operations in both locations.

The demolitions mark the latest destruction of Palestinian homes in areas under Israeli control. Nablus and Ramallah are among the most frequently targeted Palestinian population centers for such operations. Residents and rights groups have repeatedly documented waves of home demolitions across the West Bank, citing Israeli military and settlement expansion as primary drivers of the policy.
